messages:
sam: FYI product is asking for a "sparse-telemetry" mode: drop most non-error payloads for very high QPS routes to cut costs. they want a Console switch that can be turned on per-tenant-route.

nina: Need to clarify requirements: is sparse-telemetry the same as sampling? or do they want payload-stripping (keep headers/metadata only)? both have different guarantees.

sam: product wants a tiered approach: (1) metadata-only, (2) sampled payloads (low base rate w/ error/slow overrides), (3) full-fidelity. Console would surface which of the 3 is active.

omar: Important: billing/quota. If we drop payloads but continue to count tokens for billing, tenants will be confused. ops needs a clear statement: telemetry reduction != quota reduction unless customer opts in.

lisa: Agreed. We should add a UI hint: "sparse mode does not affect consumption billing unless enabled with 'billing_compaction' (enterprise opt-in)."

devops-bot: AUTO: note that enabling metadata-only will still emit request_count metrics and quotas are enforced on total request/token counters. See /policies/usage.

vanya: On PII: metadata-only must still run the redaction pre-check to avoid leaking prompt snippets in headers or error traces. For sampled payloads we need post-redaction sampling. Tech constraint: redaction is CPU-heavy. If we redaction-first for all requests we lose the cost benefit.

lee: Idea: lightweight pre-check that uses heuristics to flag high-PII risk. If high-risk, persist to full redaction pipeline regardless of sparse mode (and count toward safety quota). Else we can synthetic-redact (truncate + hash) then apply sampling.

ownar: (typo correction) — omar here. We also need to ensure routing fallbacks: if a route in sparse mode starts seeing elevated error rates, router should temporarily switch to full-fidelity logging for a small window so debugging isn't blind. This must be automatic and auditable.

sam: auto-fallback is crucial. Proposed policy: if route error-rate delta > 3x baseline or p50 latency increases > 2x for 5 min, flip to full-fidelity logging for 10 minutes and create an audit event.

nina: Let's surface that fallback in Console with a timeline indicator and an email alert option. Also allow manual override.

lisa: Retention ask from Legal: any payload we keep (even sampled) must have a TTL and be auditable. We should set a default 14 days for sparse-mode retained payloads, max 30 days with opt-in. Document in toggle details.

vanya: Fingerprinting: we should emit a tenant-scoped HMAC fingerprint for dropped payloads so we can detect duplicates/regressions without plaintext. Key rotation done via KMS/HSM. We'll need a small column in telemetry store: fingerprint_hash.

lee: For SDK behavior: iOS/Android clients sometimes bundle requests offline. If payloads are dropped server-side, we still need to correlate client logs. Add a client-sent short fingerprint header computed with tenant public salt. Docs required.

sam: Example sparse config sketch:
```
route: /v1/chat/stream
sparse_mode: sampled_payloads
sample_config:
  base_sample_rate: 0.005
  error_override: 1.0
  slow_ms_override: 1000
precheck_heuristic: pii_risk_threshold=0.7
retain_ttl_days: 14
billing_compaction: false
```

omar: Telemetry/metrics to show in console: current_sample_rate, effective_storage_bytes_saved, incidents_triggering_auto_fallback, recent_auto_fallback_windows. We should also surface a cost-savings projection based on trailing 30d usage.

nina: UX: add a small "confidence" band on savings (low/medium/high) and link to an exportable CSV showing how many requests were sampled, dropped, or fingerprinted.

lisa: Ops: when toggling sparse mode, emit audit event type `sparse_mode.toggle` with who/when/route/mode/prev_mode and snapshot the active sampler config. This helps rollbacks.

vanya: Security/PII implementation notes: hashing algorithm: HMAC-SHA256 with tenant KMS key; store only first 16 hex chars as index. No plaintext persisted. Also mask any error stack lines that reference user-provided tokens/keys.

lee: Rollout plan suggestion: alpha (internal tenants) -> beta (select customers) -> GA. Each stage gated by a runbook checklist (auto-fallback validation, retention compliance, smoke tests).

sam: Action items: @omar write router auto-fallback prototype and metric exporter (PR by Mon), @vanya spec HMAC fingerprint + KMS rotation (Thu), @lisa coordinate legal retention signoff and draft Console copy (Fri), @nina design Console panels and CSV export (Tom), @lee update SDK header docs (next Wed). I'll own rollout coordination.

devops-bot: REMINDER: add smoke job `sparse-mode-smoke` to nightly CI after alpha.

sam: thanks all. I'll post a short explainer for product to put in Console tooltip.
